title: KroxAnimated
description:

Made By MineMasterr
body:
📦 Krox_Animated PvP Pack – Small Totem, Low Shield, No Fire!

🔥 Level up your Minecraft PvP experience with this clean and performance-friendly resource pack! Designed with PvP players in mind, this pack gives you key visual advantages while keeping the original Minecraft feel.

✅ Main Features:

🛡️ Low & Small Shield
Custom shield model that takes up less space on screen – perfect for close combat and quick reactions.

🧍‍♂️ Small Totem of Undying
Smaller in-hand and pop animation for the totem, so it doesn't block your view during clutch moments.

🔥 No Fire Overlay
Replaces the default fire animation with a lower version, giving you better visibility when you're on fire.

✨ Krox_Animated Style Enhancements
Includes clean animated textures that give the game a more dynamic PvP look without being distracting.

🧱 Lightweight and PvP-Ready
Minimal changes focused on performance and visual clarity for PvP, UHC, or competitive playstyles.
